verses.text: In the beginning, God created the heavens and the earth.
The earth had no shape and was empty. Darkness covered the deep waters, and the Spirit of God was moving over the surface of the waters.
Then God said, "Let there be light." And light came into being.
God saw that the light was good. He separated the light from the darkness.
God named the light "day" and the darkness "night". Evening came, and then morning. That was the first day.
Then God said, "Let there be a wide space between the waters, to divide the waters into two parts."
So God made the wide space. He separated the waters below it from the waters above it. And it happened just as he said.
God named the wide space "sky". Evening came, and then morning. That was the second day.
Then God said, "Let the waters under the sky gather into one place, so that dry ground can appear." And it happened just as he said.
God named the dry ground "land", and the waters that had gathered together he named "seas". God saw that it was good.
Then God said, "Let the land grow plants: green plants that make seeds, and trees that bear fruit with seeds inside, each of its own kind." And it happened just as he said.
The land produced plants that made seeds, each of its own kind, and trees that bore fruit with seeds inside, each of its own kind. God saw that it was good.
Evening came, and then morning. That was the third day.
Then God said, "Let there be lights in the sky to separate the day from the night. Let them be signs that mark the seasons, the days and the years.
Let them shine in the sky to give light to the earth." And it happened just as he said.
God made two great lights: the bigger light to rule the day, and the smaller light to rule the night. He also made the stars.
God placed them in the sky to give light to the earth,
to rule over the day and the night, and to separate the light from the darkness. God saw that it was good.
Evening came, and then morning. That was the fourth day.
Then God said, "Let the waters be filled with living creatures, and let birds fly above the earth across the open sky."
So God created the great sea creatures and every kind of living thing that moves in the water. He also created every kind of bird. God saw that it was good.
God blessed them and said, "Have many young and increase in number. Fill the waters of the seas, and let the birds multiply on the earth."
Evening came, and then morning. That was the fifth day.
Then God said, "Let the land produce living creatures, each of its own kind: farm animals, small creatures that move along the ground, and wild animals." And it happened just as he said.
God made the wild animals, the farm animals and all the small creatures that move along the ground, each of its own kind. God saw that it was good.

Then God said, "Let us make human beings in our image, to be like us. Let them rule over the fish in the sea, the birds in the sky, the farm animals, the whole earth, and all the small creatures that move along the ground."
So God created human beings in his own image. In the image of God he created them. Male and female he created them.

God blessed them and said to them, "Have children and increase in number. Fill the earth and bring it under your care and control. Rule over the fish in the sea, the birds in the sky and every living creature that moves on the earth."
Then God said, "Look! I have given you every plant on the whole earth that makes seeds, and every tree that bears fruit with seeds. They will be your food.

And to every animal on the earth, every bird in the sky and every creature that moves along the ground, everything that has the breath of life in it, I give every green plant for food." And it happened just as he said.
God looked at everything he had made, and it was very good. Evening came, and then morning. That was the sixth day.
